_purpose: CardStorm Grail Board - a compact, curated showcase of real, identifiable sports cards for a small set of legendary/high-interest players, each paired with a real sold/completed-sale comp traced to a named source. This intentionally replaces the old 60-player GOAT Vault wall as the primary experience for this section. Every record here is a REAL card identity (year/brand/set/number/parallel/grade) - never a fabricated card, cert, grade, serial number, or price.
_sourcingMethod: Researched via WebSearch result summaries (this environment has no direct page-fetch access to PSA/Goldin/Fanatics/Heritage/SCP - confirmed by repeated EGRESS_BLOCKED errors, not assumed). Every comp below is cross-referenced against at least one named, linkable outlet. None of these are confirmed as the exact physical cert pictured/described - CardStorm has no card photography for any of these, so every entry is presented as a same-card-and-grade comparable sale, never as 'this exact slab sold for X', per compType.
_compLabelGuide: compType drives the UI label: EXACT_CERT_CONFIRMED -> 'Exact Cert Sale' (only when the source specifically ties the displayed cert to the transaction); SAME_CARD_AND_GRADE_COMP -> 'Recent <GRADE> Comp' (a real completed sale of the same card+grade, not proven to be this exact physical copy); SIMILAR_ITEM_COMP -> 'Similar Item Comp' (a related but not identical card/grade). Never render plain 'sold for' language for anything but EXACT_CERT_CONFIRMED.
